//: The test classpath's dbgit.json, which shadows src/main/resources' for the whole test run.
//metadata: The integration tests bind a throwaway PostgreSQL container to this port, so nothing here touches the developer's own metadata server on 5432. It is fixed rather than ephemeral because the config is read once, statically, before any container can start - so the container follows the config, not the other way round.
//branchDatabases: Postgres-flavored on purpose: ForkerTest and DbGitCommandsTest are unit tests that read BranchDatabaseConfig.getInstance() directly - the real, static singleton, the only way Forker ever gets a config now - with their own CommandRunner/ConnectorFactory stubs, and assert on these exact values (containerName, hostPort, dialect: SharedContainer.ensureRunning is a no-op unless dialect is 'postgresql') as the config for the real shared-container docker commands SharedContainer builds. DbGitIntegrationTest does not care what this section says: it builds its BranchDatabaseRepository straight off ConnectorRegistry.builtins().get("h2"), bypassing this section's dialect entirely. H2 as a genuine dialect is covered directly against ConnectorRegistry in BranchDatabaseRepositoryH2Test, independent of whatever this file says.
